correctness.rationale: Hub/periphery block splitting gives 2-by-2 eigenvalues 1,-p and zero-sum peripheral eigenvalues (1−p)mu_j/d. Detailed balance gives stationary pi_h=p/(1+p), each peripheral 1/[N(1+p)]; reversibility makes SLEM the sharp weighted-L2 contraction, while independent equal-variance initial errors give sigma² sum pi². Variance derivative is 2sigma²(p−1/N)/(1+p)^3 and speed is the max of two monotone lines, so the displayed Pareto interval and exact penalty follow. L>=1 follows trace A_H²=Nd, d<=N-2. Fresh independent full transition-matrix eigen/variance checks succeeded for 15 cases of connected and disconnected regular bases.
residual_risks: Finite tests corroborate but do not replace the analytic infinite/domain-general proof.
